description: The boot stage machine (client boot behaviour, outside the wire contract), owned by `@polaris-key/client-core/stages` and ported to every SDK. Each row starts from `initialBootState(init)` (an omitted option takes its default: allowOffline true, allowGrace true, requiredPacks []) and feeds `bootTransition` its steps in order; each step lists the exact emits that event produces, `stage_changed` first. `expect.stages` is every stage entered, in order, and its last entry is the final stage; `expect.outcome` is the final outcome. Events are dotted, emits snake_case, payload keys camelCase and payload values kebab-case. An event the current stage does not accept, or a malformed one, is ignored: the state comes back unchanged with no emits. `accepts` lists what each stage accepts (`gate:waiting` is the gate while it waits for the player), and a runner sends every probe at the initial state and after every step of every row, asserting an unchanged state and no emits exactly when the probe's type is not accepted there. `guardCases` pin `bootGuardAction`, which rolls back at `maxFailedBoots`. Append-only: a change to the vocabulary, to `accepts` or to an existing row's expectation bumps `stageMatrixVersion`.

blocked — version-too-old requires an update
blocked — version-too-new is not available
ready — channel-not-entitled blocks, and retry continues once entitled
ready — by default a sync timeout continues offline and grace passes
offline — allowGrace false refuses grace offline
waiting — offline and not yet activated still reaches activation
ready — an offline first launch of a config-only product continues on its defaults
ready — a sync error continues from local state
offline — allowOffline false stops when the network is unreachable
error — allowOffline false stops with sync-failed on a server error
ready — allowOffline false: a timeout stops, play-offline is ignored, retry syncs
ready — an optional update continues and emits update_available

ready — a failed download never blocks when the required set is present
ready — a rolled-back boot continues and emits boot_rolled_back
ready — an applied staged update continues

ready — a host failure ends in error, and retry syncs again
ready — background work after ready returns to ready
error — expired after a server error stops with sync-failed

ready — fail while the gate waits, and fail and retry after ready, are ignored

ready — a shell failure ends in error, and retry runs the shell again

ready — a fetch failure ends in error, and retry syncs again
waiting — revoked without a network waits for the player

blocked — channel-not-entitled without a network is not available
ready — not-applicable passes the gate after a server error
ready — grace passes the gate after a server error

guardCases.name: none — nothing staged and no failed boots
apply-staged — a staged update is applied
none — one failed boot does not roll back
apply-staged — a staged update replaces a slot with one failure
roll-back — two failed boots roll back
roll-back — a rollback takes precedence over a staged update
roll-back — more than two failed boots still roll back
